meta_title: Free VPN Comparison: VpnHood! vs ProtonVPN & NordVPN
meta_description: VpnHood! CONNECT's free tier vs ProtonVPN, Windscribe, Hotspot Shield and NordVPN: unlimited traffic, split tunneling, open source client and server.
page_title: VPN brands comparison in the free tier
page_desc: Compare data limits, registration, open-source code and split tunneling to find a free VPN that fits your needs.
table_caption: Free-plan comparison of VpnHood! CONNECT, ProtonVPN, Windscribe and Hotspot Shield, with NordVPN included as a paid-service reference.
note: NordVPN is included as a paid-service reference; it has no permanent free tier. Comparison reflects each provider's publicly available free plan at the time of writing and may change. All third-party product names, logos and trademarks are the property of their respective owners and are used here for identification only.
why_desc: VpnHood! CONNECT combines unlimited free traffic, open-source client and server code, flexible split tunneling and Cloak Mode. The free plan includes ads; Premium adds more locations and features.
why_unlimited_desc: Browse without a data cap or account registration. There is no artificial bandwidth throttling, though actual speeds depend on your network and server load. The free plan is funded by ads, so it is not available in every country.
why_open_source_desc: Both the client and server code are published on GitHub for inspection. You can review the implementation and run your own server.
why_split_desc: Choose which traffic uses the VPN by country, app or local network, so you can tailor your connection to the services you use.
why_stealth_desc: Cloak Mode helps disguise VPN traffic as ordinary HTTPS traffic. Effectiveness depends on the network's filtering methods; no connection is guaranteed to remain unblocked.
